recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1970s soul album cover featuring a central framed portrait of a woman with an afro, set against a deep blue textured background with a vibrant red border and psychedelic, bubble-style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: A thick red outer border containing a deep blue field.
A central rectangular portrait framed by thin concentric white, red, and blue lines.
A large, expressive logotype positioned directly above the central frame.
Secondary sans-serif text aligned to the top and left margins.
coreInvariants: Deep cobalt blue background with visible paper grain/texture.
Multi-line pinstripe border around the central image.
White psychedelic lettering with a thick red drop shadow.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central portrait occupies the lower-middle third of the canvas, framed tightly.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, stylized script logo in the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold white logo, moves down to the framed portrait, then scans the secondary text in the top corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial blue field surrounding the central elements to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Red (Outer border and drop shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primaries with a dark value background to make white elements pop.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Groovy, high-contrast script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Main logo: Thick, rounded, bulbous terminals with extreme weight contrast.
Secondary text: Tight kerning, medium-weight geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital 'C' and 'S' featuring elongated, swirling swashes.
Lowercase letters with tight, overlapping connections.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, organic custom script and rigid, modern geometric sans-serif.

preserve: The bulbous terminals of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s psychedelic weight and flow.
Matches the tight, geometric feel of the secondary display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vintage 1970s album cover background. A solid deep cobalt blue field with a thick vibrant red outer border. In the center, place a vertical rectangular portrait of a person with a large afro, framed by a thin multi-line border of white, red, and blue. The photo should have a grainy, warm, analog film quality.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white, psychedelic bubble-style script logo in the upper center with a thick red hard drop shadow. Add a single line of bold white geometric sans-serif text at the very top center. Add a block of small, left-aligned white sans-serif text in the top left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the blue background textured like old paper?
Is the script logo thick and bulbous?
Does the central frame consist of multiple thin colored lines?
Is the red border solid and consistent?

adjustableVariables: Width of the outer red border
Intensity of the blue background texture
Color of the drop shadow on the script
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Record label logos or catalog numbers
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the script text has no transparency.
Verify the pinstripe frame is perfectly centered around the photo.
Check that the red border does not bleed into the blue field.
Confirm the grain texture is visible across the entire blue area.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured primary-color field with a pinstripe-framed central photo and heavy 70s-style display typography.
